limits: Provisional positives may be mislabelled; no independent truth or identity claims.
Positive-only loss rewards score inflation and cannot learn background rejection; reduced loss is not measured improvement.
Fine-tuning changes one existing objectness bias; backbone, vessel and offset heads remain frozen. This is not full fine-tuning.
Member zero before/after is the matched architecture control; the production 12-member flip-TTA ensemble is different.
CROMA has an 8px token stride without offset refinement; raw scores are not calibrated across architectures.
Approaches use identical supported development areas and fixed policy/grid, but only xView3 uses native 2048 contexts.
Unresolved objects, clutter, empty areas and AIS silence are never negatives; validation annotations never enter fitting.
HH/HV is excluded. Labrador model coverage remains absent.
Accuracy intervals need reviewed truth; optimizer seeds are not independent data samples.
Pretraining overlap and prior development exposure are limitations.
Encoder adaptation deferred pending useful frozen-head evidence.
